F-ZON-23 | returns.receiving_location = zone_a | All customer returns must be received in Zone A through dock doors 1-4 and must not be received in Zone D.; F-ZON-24 | returns.post_inspection_holding_location = zone_f | Inspected returns must be kept physically in Zone F until disposition is approved and posted in the WMS and must not be moved to bulk storage, picking or dispatch staging before approval.; F-ZON-25 | hazmat_return.segregation_location = zone_f_adjacent_to_hazmat_cage | Any return marked hazmat, leaking or odorous must be segregated adjacent to the hazmat cage in Zone F for specialist assessment and not opened on the general inspection bench.; F-RSP-14 | returns_exception.notification_recipient = shift_supervisor | Any return that cannot be identified, is contaminated or presents a safety risk must be held in Zone F and the shift supervisor notified for instruction.; F-ORD-16 | returns_inspection.duty_sequence = verify_return_and_window_then_open_count_examine_then_photograph_retain_labels_then_propose_disposition | Returns staff must execute PR-07 inspection in order: verify return against delivery and 14-day window, then open/count/examine condition, then photograph damage and retain labels, then propose restock/rework/scrap.; F-ORD-17 | returns_handling.wms_record_before_move_order = record_inspection_outcome_before_moving | The inspection outcome must be recorded in the WMS before the physical return is moved from Zone F.

F-ZON-26 | damaged_goods.quarantine_location = zone_f_quarantine_area | All goods awaiting disposition under PR-09 Damaged-goods handling must be held in the quarantine area in Zone F.; F-ZON-27 | rework_goods.destination_location = zone_f | Approved rework goods under PR-07/PR-09 must be routed to the designated work area in Zone F.; F-RSP-15 | damaged_goods.large_write_off_endorser = shift_supervisor | For damaged-goods write-offs above 500 EUR the shift supervisor must endorse the request and forward it to the warehouse manager for final decision.

message: F-RSP-16 | stocktake.recount_performer = different_counter_than_first_count | A stocktake recount must be assigned to a different counter than the first count.; F-RSP-17 | stocktake.recount_verifier = stock_controller | The stock controller must verify the recount result before any adjustment is posted.; F-RSP-18 | stocktake.count_team_independence = independent_from_normal_operating_area | Counting teams must be independent from the stockholding area they normally operate.; F-ORD-18 | stocktake.system_release_order = sign_off_before_release | The WMS/system must not be released for normal operations until the warehouse manager sign-off is recorded.

F-ZON-28 | hazmat.staging_location = hazmat_cage | Hazmat must be staged only inside the hazmat cage in Zone F.; F-ZON-29 | cold_chain_affected_stock.holding_location = zone_e | Affected chilled stock subject to a temperature alarm must be held inside Zone E and tagged pending decision.; F-RSP-19 | chilled_goods.release_authoriser = shift_supervisor | Chilled goods must not be moved to another zone until the shift supervisor authorises release.; F-RSP-20 | cold_zone_temperature_alarm.notification_recipient = shift_supervisor | Any cold-zone temperature alarm or out-of-range reading must be notified to the shift supervisor without delay.; F-ORD-19 | hazmat_spill_response.execution_order = stop_work_and_alert > notify_shift_supervisor > ventilate_and_isolate > don_ppe_and_deploy_spill_kit > contain_absorb_collect_and_log | Spill response under PR-13 must be executed in order: stop work and alert, notify shift supervisor, ventilate and isolate, don PPE and deploy spill kit, contain/absorb/collect and log.; F-ORD-20 | cold_chain_alarm_response.execution_order = recheck_at_calibrated_display_in_zone_e > keep_doors_closed_and_restrict_entry > notify_shift_supervisor > hold_and_tag_stock_in_zone_e > await_authorised_release | Cold-chain alarm response under PR-12 must be executed in order: recheck at calibrated display inside Zone E, keep doors closed/restrict entry, notify shift supervisor, hold and tag affected stock inside Zone E, do not move until shift supervisor authorises release.
